candidates.question: Can I keep possession after the cash sale closes?
candidates.reason: Existing guide already compares later closing with documented post-closing occupancy, costs, coverage, responsibilities and delayed-move contingency. No separate possession variant warranted.

candidates.question: Should I cancel my flood policy when I accept an offer?
candidates.reason: Newly published Nov27 guide already answers this with NFIP building-policy assignment versus cancellation, buyer choice, written confirmation and effective-date coordination. No replay or synonym page.

candidates.question: Must I finish tobacco-odor preparation before requesting an offer?
candidates.reason: Existing guide directly answers current-condition evaluation versus defined preparation scope, rejects device guarantees and compares costs, responsibilities and marketing tradeoffs.
